up: List the ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for all compounds that have been tested in assays where the target is human arginase 2 (mitochondrial) and the assay organism is Homo sapiens. Return one row per unique compound.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.pref_name = 'arginase-2, mitochondrial' AND ass.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'
